articles.title: Oil Tanker Hijacking Stokes Fear of Links Between Houthi Rebels and Somali Pirates
articles.summary: Houthi rebels and Somali pirates may be collaborating after an oil tanker hijacking in the Middle East. The location and timing of the attack fueled concerns about collaboration between Somali pirates and the Iran-backed Houthi rebels in Yemen under the cover of Mideast turmoil.

articles.title: Trump Says US Will "Guide Ships" Safely Out Of Strait Of Hormuz

articles.title: Iran says US has responded to its latest peace proposal
articles.summary: Iran claims the US responded to its peace proposal, but Trump called it unacceptable. The US is yet to formally confirm it has responded. However, Trump reportedly told Israel's Kan News it was unacceptable.

articles.title: Global Demand for Rare Earth Minerals Is Intensifying Criminal Threats in the Amazon Rainforest
articles.summary: Global demand for rare earth minerals is fueling a surge in criminal activity in the Amazon Rainforest, where thieves target critical minerals used in drones and electric cars. Global demand for critical minerals, used to build drones and electric cars, is surging, setting of a new wave of criminality in the world’s largest rainforest.

articles.title: Modern economic chokepoints in war and the impact on geopolitics
articles.summary: The Iran war and the blockade of the Strait of Hormuz have exposed modern economic chokepoints, revealing new strategies in geopolitics and war. Hoover Institution fellow Eyck Freymann explains what the Iran war and the blockade of the Straight of Hormuz reveals about modern economic chokepoints, geopolitics and war strategies.

articles.title: How does diplomacy work during a military deadlock?
articles.summary: Diplomatic efforts are underway during a military stalemate, with experts citing nuanced moves to de-escalate tensions and find a peaceful resolution. Suzanne DiMaggio, senior fellow at the Carnegie Endowment for International Peace, explains the nuances of diplomatic moves at a time of military stalemate.

articles.title: Iran lawmaker says Strait of Hormuz will not return to pre‑war state
articles.summary: Iran has vowed that the Strait of Hormuz will never return to its pre-war state, following the US-Israel war on Tehran. Iran says the Strait of Hormuz will never return to the status quo that existed before the US-Israel war on Tehran.

articles.title: Trump says US will ‘help free up’ ships stuck in Hormuz Strait

articles.summary: The Jaffer Express train is a vital lifeline through Pakistan's Balochistan. We witnessed crossfire while waiting for the Jaffer Express, a vital lifeline through Balochistan. For many, it’s the only way home.
